title: Cloud Test Machine power
summary: A Test Machine whose settings record cloud_instance_id is an EC2 instance powered from the executing machine with the project's aws-admin key. Contract materialization (resolve_contract_host_control), yoke test-machine operations and declared-host Commands start a stopped instance, wait for instance-running and a successful key login over SSH, then continue. The process records each cloud machine it powered; when its leasing flow ends (operation, standalone case, plan run, mission walk-end, review submit) it stops each one test_machine.get shows with no active lease. A queued waiter's reserved turn is a lease, so the host runs until the last one ends. A lease the server releases with no client flow ending (a reaped execution, a manual claim release) leaves the host running until its next lease ends. A Command that runs several yoke test-machine operations must declare method_config.test_machine (authoring now also catches yoke --env prod test-machine), so the plan holds the host across them instead of each nested operation's release stopping it. Start failures refuse with test_machine_power_start_failed, test_machine_power_ssh_unreachable or test_machine_power_aws_unavailable, each naming the recovery; stop problems print test_machine_power_stop_failed and never change the flow's result. An instance without an Elastic IP is never stopped (test_machine_power_stop_skipped), because its registered host address would change. Machines without cloud_instance_id are untouched. Source behavior awaits live CloudTrail proof.
